definitions.explanation: A strong feeling of dislike, repulsion, or moral disapproval toward something or someone. Composed of 嫌悪 (disgust/aversion) + 感 (feeling).

examples.japanese: {嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I felt a strong sense of disgust at that remark.

examples.japanese: {暴力的|ぼうりょくてき}な⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are quite a few people who show revulsion toward violent imagery.

notes:
USAGE:
{嫌悪感|けんおかん} is stronger than simply not liking something — it conveys visceral repulsion or moral disapproval. It is commonly used in writing, news, and formal discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (harbor feelings of disgust)
- {嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (feel disgust)
- {嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (show disgust)
- {嫌悪感|けんおかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (have a feeling of aversion)
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{嫌悪感|けんおかん} (strong revulsion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{不快感|ふかいかん}→不快感：15750_fukaikan⟧ means "feeling of discomfort" and is milder. ⟦{嫌悪|けんお}→嫌悪：05998_keno⟧ without ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ is the abstract concept of aversion rather than the subjective feeling.
